messages:
nina: Hey @people-ops — quick one. Partner has a specialist appt in Madrid tomorrow. We added them as a dependent but the enrollment processed late and no card arrived. Clinic is asking for member ID + group number. Is a screenshot of the member portal ok? Any fast official proof we can get remotely?

rachel (People Ops): Short: usually a portal PDF or insurer proof letter works. Try: Benefits portal -> View ID -> Print -> Save as PDF (gives a file with member & group numbers). If that doesn't include group, call insurer and request an "expedited proof of coverage" emailed to you. We can also submit on your behalf via our broker.

nina: Portals are weird overseas — print-as-pdf cropped the group. I can call insurer but wanted a script.

devin: I did this in Barcelona — screenshot on phone + clinic called insurer verification line and that was enough. Ask clinic if they'll call.

rachel (People Ops): Script: "Hello, I need an expedited proof of coverage emailed for dependent [name], DOB [mm/dd/yyyy]. Appointment tomorrow, need member ID & group on letter. Can you email it to [email] now?" If you want us to push it, DM full name, DOB, last4 and we'll escalate.

people-ops-bot: Links: Enrollment dashboard https://hr.example.com/dependents and "Request expedited coverage letter" form.

nina: DMing details now. Thanks all :pray:
